vocab.ex: J'étais intimidé par les autres candidats, qui semblaient très expérimentés.
vocab.exEn: I felt intimidated by the other candidates, who seemed very experienced.

vocab.mean: to dare; to feel able to try despite hesitation
vocab.ex: Cette fois, il a osé poser sa question au professeur.
vocab.exEn: This time, he dared to ask the teacher his question.

vocab.mean: to be up to the task; to meet expectations
vocab.ex: Pour organiser cet accueil, les bénévoles ont été à la hauteur.
vocab.exEn: The volunteers rose to the occasion when organising this welcome.

vocab.ex: Tu te sous-estimes : tu as déjà organisé deux événements.
vocab.exEn: You're underestimating yourself: you've already organised two events.

vocab.mean: to have stage fright; to feel nervous before a performance
vocab.ex: J'ai le trac avant de présenter mon projet aux voisins.
vocab.exEn: I feel nervous before presenting my project to the neighbours.

vocab.mean: to become flustered; to lose your composure
vocab.ex: Quand tout le monde l'a regardé, il a perdu ses moyens.
vocab.exEn: When everyone looked at him, he became flustered.

vocab.mean: a skill; an ability used to perform a task
vocab.ex: La gestion des réservations fait partie de ses compétences.
vocab.exEn: Managing bookings is one of her skills.

vocab.ex: Je reconnais mes limites et je demande conseil pour cette étape.
vocab.exEn: I acknowledge my limits and ask for advice with this step.

vocab.mean: to step back; to gain perspective
vocab.ex: Avant de tout modifier, prenons du recul sur les remarques reçues.
vocab.exEn: Before changing everything, let's step back and consider the feedback.

vocab.mean: to question yourself; to reassess your approach
vocab.ex: Elle sait se remettre en question quand une méthode ne fonctionne plus.
vocab.exEn: She can reassess her approach when a method no longer works.

vocab.mean: to take the plunge; to get started with something new
vocab.ex: Après plusieurs recettes, elle s'est lancée dans un concours de cuisine.
vocab.exEn: After several recipes, she took the plunge and entered a cooking competition.

vocab.mean: to prove what you can do
vocab.ex: Il a fait ses preuves en accompagnant les nouveaux membres du club.
vocab.exEn: He proved himself by helping the club's new members.

vocab.mean: to grow more confident; to become more self-assured
vocab.ex: En répondant aux visiteurs, il a gagné en assurance au fil des semaines.
vocab.exEn: By answering visitors' questions, he grew more confident over the weeks.

vocab.mean: to have self-confidence; to believe in your abilities
vocab.ex: Elle a confiance en elle quand elle organise une visite.
vocab.exEn: She feels confident when organising a visit.
